title: Owner-authorized saved Dune query provenance smoke
objective: Create and execute one private saved G2 Bitcoin transaction-count query to validate durable Dune query identity before broad collector implementation.
owner_authorization: Owner authorized Dune query creation and execution for the daily macro workflow.
forbidden_actions: Do not create more than one private saved query; do not create dashboards or visualizations.
Do not execute any query other than the saved completed-day BTC transaction-count query.
Do not write PostgreSQL data or send Hermes/Feishu messages.
Do not enable BSC/Robinhood adapters, backfills, trading, signing or execution capability.
deliverables: A sanitized report with saved query ID, SQL hash, execution state/times, result checksum, aggregate value, and cleanup/retention decision.
